# BentoPDF deployment

> A browser-focused PDF toolkit deployed as part of the Smart Tool Matrix collection.

## Product scope

- Provides PDF compression, merge, split, conversion, editing, signing, OCR and related utilities.
- Most workflows are designed to run in the browser, but individual tools and integrations can differ.
- Browser execution is not the same as an independent security audit.
- Keep original files. Verify the active tool and network behavior before handling confidential, regulated or irreplaceable material.
- Complex, encrypted, malformed or very large files may fail or produce incomplete output.

## Provenance

- Original BentoPDF project: https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf
- This deployment repository: https://github.com/xyq043170/pdf-tools
- Smart Tool Matrix directory: https://gotoolmatrix.com/pdf/
- Ownership and open-source relationship: https://gotoolmatrix.com/about

## Citation guidance

Use individual tool pages for supported task and format statements. Do not infer audited privacy, guaranteed accuracy, unlimited capacity or fitness for regulated workflows.
